Treasure Item 2012 T107: Complete silver Roman finger ring, Henig Type XI, dating to the 2nd - 3rd century AD. The ring is roughly D-shaped with a broad flat bezel and sub-circular hoop. The bezel, which is sub-rectangular in shape, has bevelled shoulders carrying impressed semi-circular detailing outlined with an incised line. This semi-circular detailing flanks either end of the rectangular bezel and below this the shoulders taper to form the narrowed hoop of the ring. Both the shoulders and hoop, which are undecorated, are plano-convex in section.
